text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While taking a stroll along the riverside,
I see
someone familiar.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I thought all the paths were closed off to
me, but
because you extended a kind
hand to me, I...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Fancy seeing you here!
CUUUT!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, Kita! You can't break character
in the
middle of a scene like that! Let's
take it once
more from the top!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Aw, man! Acting is a steep road to climb...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh! You see, Kita has asked for my
guidance
and has set off on the path to
becoming a movie
star!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, don't get the wrong idea! This
isn't for a
movie, and I'm just going to be
an extra!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
One of the TV shows I like is recruiting
extras at the moment, so I thought I'd
give it a shot and try
applying for a
spot...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: However!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My sixth—no, my seventh sense is tingling. It's saying that your talents far exceed that of an extra!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With your innate star qualities and my
guidance,
I'm positive you could become
a real prima
donna!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What?! But I'm fine being an extra! Plus,
I can
only participate in one day of
filming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring T.M. Opera O's booming
laughter, I must
say, I'm surprised that
Kitasan Black is interested
in acting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her dad has been in the entertainment
industry for a long time and is quite
talented. If Kitasan
Black asked, I'm sure
he'd be happy to help her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well...
choice_data_list: Why didn't you ask your dad to tra...
Why didn't you ask your dad to tra...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's because I want to surprise him.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not the only one who likes this
show. My whole family loves it as well.
Whenever I'm
back home, we all watch it
together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we'll all sit on the sofa and
watch it together the next time I'm home
too. Then, out of
nowhere, my face will
show up on the TV...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And I bet Dad will be over the moon.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Much like Christine, you strive to
please your father through your own
power, even if it
means settling for a
minor supporting role.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh... Very well.
choice_data_list: She's a girl brimming with guts an...
And with the skills I've gained, I...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, I shall play not the phantom,
but a
jack-of-all-trades, capable of
solving all
problems.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will shutter that light of hers,
fit for a main role,
so she may glimmer for an
instance as a side character... What a
difficult task this will be.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thanks! I'm looking forward to
learning more
about acting from you,
Opera—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But first, you must run toward the sunset!
Let the
emotions inside your heart ignite
and burst forth!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The advice T.M. Opera O offers is quite
unique
and... difficult to understand,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Determinatiooon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's personality is innately
sincere, so
she's able to absorb all of
T.M. Opera O's advice
to great effect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, Kitasan Black happily
tells me how she watched the show she
appeared in as an
extra, alongside her
dad.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, wait! I'm only applying for a
role as
an extra!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know your potential! You possess the
talent of someone who will one day
become a leader in the world of theater!
One worthy to act alongside me in my
own performances!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, then! I must impart upon you the
necessary
skills to accomplish that!
Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What is going on?! Hang on a minute,
you two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to all of T.M. Opera O's
diligent
mentoring in the art of acting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black almost gets chosen to star in a certain TV show... but that's a story for another time.
